title: Min Cost to Connect All Points
keyIdea: This is a minimum spanning tree on the complete graph (edge cost = Manhattan distance). With n² edges, Prim's with a plain minDist array is O(n²): repeatedly add the closest point outside the tree, then update every outside point's cheapest edge to the tree.

approaches.name: Prim's with an array (dense graph)
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). minDist[0] = 0; n times: pick the outside point with the smallest minDist, add it, relax every outside point with its distance to it.
approaches.why: n steps, each scanning n points twice; no edge list is built.
